card.name: Digits in US ZIP codes
card.fires_on: The first or second digit of a ZIP code after a US state abbreviation in a postal address. It also fires weakly on a few other spots in institution names and ISBNs.

modes.label: ZIP code digits
modes.description: A digit starting a five-digit ZIP code right after a state abbreviation in a mailing address.

modes.label: Institution name joiners
modes.description: An ampersand or comma inside a long institution or office name.
modes.example: School of Engineering<< &>> Applied Science and lead author

card.writes: It suppresses street-type words such as Street and Avenue, which fits being past the street part of an address.
card.plain: It marks the digits of a ZIP code at the end of a mailing address.
